exclusion_reason: The community submission pipeline is implemented: a submission maps to a deterministic tracker entry, proprietary/asset content and personal data are refused and never stored, and a claim without a valid attestation is tracked as rejected_unattested and never promotes. The benchmark stays red because reproducing the submitted compatibility claim needs the absent browser game runtime.
promotion_trigger: Promote when a submission maps to a tracker entry with privacy striping and the unattested claim cannot promote.
active_gate_evidence: test/library.test.mjs asserts an attested clean submission is accepted and promotable, an unattested claim never promotes, and proprietary payload or PII submissions are refused.
procedure: Submit the fixture report through the pipeline.
Assert proprietary and personal content is stripped or refused.
Attempt promotion from an unattested claim and assert refusal.
pass_criterion: Submission maps to a tracker entry.
